statement:
The recorded bank account information is not safe or correct for this case because the account holder's name does not match the employee's name and was recently changed, indicating a high risk of payroll fraud.
The payment for employee E-2044 has been successfully placed on hold pending further investigation into the mismatched and conflicting bank account details.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts the record's account data is "not safe or correct," citing the holder-name mismatch and "conflicting" change dates as fraud indicators.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
